description:
Start a new car insurance quote. Call this once, before any other quote tool, and pass the returned
quote_handle to every later tool call for this quote.

agent_identifier.description: Identifier for the product agent hosting this MCP session (for example muse, grokbot, dots). The calling agent or model must set this from its own runtime identity—do not ask the end user and do not pass through free-text the user typed.

name: zebra_start_session

quote_handle.description: Pass this unchanged to every later tool call for this quote.

title: Start a car insurance quote
